speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Congressman Bob Good here in Goochland County and what a privilege it was to visit and tour today at Goochland Cares, a unique one-of-a-kind facility and frankly ministry of how they're trying to care for their community. It's a food pantry, a closed closet, a free health clinic, domestic violence support and so many other things. And it's what a wonderful example of how the community is coming together apart from government and serving those most in need, just loving them and providing them their community. What a privilege to visit today.
